biotools.summary: Genomics 2 Notebook (g2nb) combines Jupyter Notebook functionality with bioinformatics tools like those found in Galaxy and GenePattern, providing a platform for non-programming scientists to perform genomics analyses.  It is a free, public resource offering both installation options and documentation.
biotools.name: Genomics Notebook (g2nb)
